info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Service Agency Management API
info.description: The Product Service Agency Management API allows users to update the details of a specific product service agency. This endpoint is designed for consumers such as banking institutions and financial service providers, enabling them to maintain accurate and up-to-date information regarding their product service agencies. With a straightforward PATCH operation, developers can efficiently modify attributes associated with product services. This functionality supports various use cases, including compliance updates, service enhancements, and operational adjustments.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific product service agency identified by its unique reference ID (PROD-700045). Make sure to include only the fields that need to be updated in your request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the attributes of a product within the external agency's service. The structure of the payload follows the defined schema for a PATCH operation, allowing for partial updates to the product's properties.
